question: Based on the state each female legislator first represented, which state has the highest number of female legislators whose terms included December 31st at any point, and what is that count? Please provide the state's abbreviation.
sql:
WITH female_legislators AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide
    FROM legislators
    WHERE gender = 'F'
),
terms_with_dec31 AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE (CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_end, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2)
       OR (CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= CAST(CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) || '-12-31' AS DATE))
),
female_with_dec31 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fl.id_bioguide
    FROM female_legislators fl
    INNER JOIN terms_with_dec31 td ON fl.id_bioguide = td.id_bioguide
),
first_state AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (fl.id_bioguide)
        fl.id_bioguide,
        lt.state
    FROM female_with_dec31 fl
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON fl.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    ORDER BY fl.id_bioguide, CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) ASC
)
SELECT state, COUNT(*) as count
FROM first_state
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 10;
